## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools
- **Date:** 2026-06-17  
  **Link:** [Google: AMIE for disease management](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-research/amie-for-disease-management-in-nature/)  
  **Summary:** Google published Nature-linked research on AMIE, its conversational medical AI, reporting performance comparable to primary-care physicians in complex disease-management scenarios.  
  **Why it matters:** Medical-agent evaluation is moving from narrow Q&A toward longitudinal care management, a higher-stakes operational setting.

- **Date:** 2026-06-17  
  **Link:** [OpenAI: AI chemist improves reaction](https://openai.com/index/ai-chemist-improves-reaction)  
  **Summary:** OpenAI and Molecule.one described a near-autonomous AI chemist using GPT-5.4 to improve a difficult medicinal-chemistry reaction.  
  **Why it matters:** The relevant signal is not a new model, but applied agent capability in closed-loop scientific R&D.

- **Date:** 2026-06-17  
  **Link:** [Anthropic: Seoul office and Korean AI ecosystem](https://www.anthropic.com/news/seoul-office-partnerships-korean-ai-ecosystem)  
  **Summary:** Anthropic opened a Seoul office and said Korean firms including NAVER, Samsung SDS, LG CNS, Hanwha, and Nexon are deploying Claude, Claude Code, or Claude Cowork.  
  **Why it matters:** Indicates continued enterprise distribution push in Korea, with engineering and knowledge-work deployments as the main vector.
